source_events.text: Still shooting music clips the old way? Wrong!
Kinetic on-screen hook text paraphrases the voiceover; final phrase is a rejection cue.
Simply upload a photo and a song and you'll get your own music.
Rhythmic performance/music bed audible after the explanatory voiceover; exact lyric content not transcribed.
No distinct isolated Foley event is reliable enough to preserve independently from the source mix.

notes: Single-pass evidence: complete 0.5-second contact sheet, decoded first/end frames, scene-boundary neighborhoods around 0.800s/2.633s/3.800s, high-resolution action/UI/face crops, and separate Whisper base.en audio transcript. Source identities, brand names, product claims, and UI semantics are deliberately not target truth. Time values use frame-aligned 30fps boundaries where visual phase transitions were observed; terminal end-card classification is retained for routing only.
